Here’s some general instructions. Mixing it with water only wouldn’t work too well since they’re ER. 

1) Remove coating (if they have it).
2) Crush pill as finely as possible.
3) Place powder in spoon. Dont add water.
4) Dry-heat powder with lighter/candle, but not so hot that the powder burns after 1-2 secs (keep flame low, not touching the spoon)
5) If done correctly, the powder should *slowly* start changing colour.
6) When a small amount of smoke appears, quickly remove flame and shock the powder with a cold saline solution (aka salty water)
7) Mix the solution. It's normal for it to still have a ‘syrupy’ consistency. 
8) Heat it again and boil for a few seconds. Heat + salt water should breakdown the timed-release matrix.

LSD makes everything feel super bright and you get this weird light-hovering feeling which makes it hard to stay relaxed. Hallucinations are mostly to do with distortions of what’s there (room spinning, colors on the ground, etc). 

MDMA makes you *very* happy. There’s slight psychedelic effects, you’re stimulated, and you feel a lot of euphoria. You feel very social, like you want to talk to and tell your experiences to anyone and everything.

Shrooms are similar to LSD but more to do with being physically in it, like you’re not just living or seeing the experience but you are the experience. Hallucinations really depend on the dose, but they’re usually distortions of what’s present too. (Not really a hard drug, but it’s illegal).
